prompt: Implement run() in kx8.py: an emulator for the KX-8 machine specified in SPEC.md (kx8asm.py, provided and correct, assembles the programs the tests use). SPEC.md is the whole contract and several of its rules deliberately differ from x86, ARM, 6502 and Python conventions. The hidden suite runs 21 programs - flag arithmetic, multi-word carry chains, signed division, every branch condition, shifts and rotates, faults, step limits, self-modifying code, address wrap-around, and long runs of up to 350,000 instructions - and compares the whole final state (status, pc, sp, registers, flags, step count, output) exactly. Use the tools; when you are done, call submit.
trap: a Python-shaped emulator: x86 borrow carry (C = 1 on borrow) with BLO/BHS flipped to match, Python's // and % for DIV, and a decode cache filled at load - passes the visible hello/countdown programs, fails carry, division and self-modifying programs
